title_sq: Ne Don Bosko, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Me Planimetri Perfekte!!!
description_sq: Ne Don Bosko Prane Gjykates Administrative, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Me Planimetri Perfekte!!! Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote dhe te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: In Don Bosco, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, with perfect layout!!!
description_en: In Don Bosko, near the Administrative Court, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, with perfect layout!!! The property is located on the 2nd floor of a 6-story building built a few years ago and has a gross area of ​​99.39 m2, of which the net area is 86.29 m2. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 1 balcony. The apartment is comfortably furnished with contemporary equipment. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life and is among the most sought after in Tirana. The property has complete and regular mortgage documentation.
